props.name: height
props.description:
Height property
- If set, the menu will be constrained to this height in px and enable vertical scrolling

props.name: id
props.description:
Id attribute
- Unique id used for A11y
- Associate the menu with the trigger that controls its open/close state

props.name: indentGroupItems
props.description:
Indent group items attribute
**true** - Applies padding to left align the text on group Menu Items with the text of the group Header
**false** - Does not apply extra padding

props.name: label
props.description:
Label attribute
- Sets ariaLabel for A11y

props.name: variant
props.description:
Variant
- **default** Display the menu items with a background and padding
- **simple** Display the menu items without a background and padding

props.name: width
props.description:
Width property
- If set, the menu will be constrained to this width in px

events.name: onMenuItemSelect
events.description: Bubbled from `<al-menu-item>` (bubbles + composed). Bind the listener HERE on `<al-menu>`, not on each item. `e.detail.value` carries the selected item's `value` attribute. Example: <al-menu @onMenuItemSelect=${(e) => handleSelect(e.detail.value)}> <al-menu-item value="edit">Edit</al-menu-item> </al-menu>

slots.description: The menu items in the menu (children must be `<al-menu-item>`).
